name: Additive noradrenergic effects
actions: Review for additive activation and cardiovascular effects when combining noradrenergic agents.
Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, agitation, tremor, and insomnia when clinically appropriate.
Use additional caution in patients with cardiovascular disease or poorly controlled hypertension.

rationale: Combined noradrenergic effects may increase activation and cardiovascular adverse effects.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both increase noradrenergic activity. Combined use may increase activation, blood-pressure, or heart-rate effects (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping noradrenergic effects may increase activation and cardiovascular burden.
